stepSummaries:
1. For each file in the phase-1 flagged list, extend the file so all 5 dimensions of the combined lens are explicit: add/strengthen intuition layer (conceptual depth), add/strengthen variants & trade-offs table (topical breadth), add/strengthen debugging/failure-mode section (production reality), add/strengthen historical-evolution note (historical evolution), audit/strengthen section challenges (pedagogical craft). Preserve existing content (D003). [verified]
  2. Run contamination spot-check on each upgraded file: each section challenge must reference the local section topic, not be a recycled prompt from another domain (per CONTAMINATION_GUARDS.md patterns). [verified]
  3. Add a dated entry to 00_CONTEXT/CHANGE_JOURNAL.md summarizing the audit (date, lens version, 22-folder summary, 02_Data_Structures flagged count), the lens definition change, the chosen folder, and the files upgraded. Include a back-link to 00_CONTEXT/PEDAGOGY_AUDIT_2026.md. [verified]
  4. If the rubric edit to PEDAGOGY_STANDARDS.md introduced a permanent rule, add a D014 entry to 00_CONTEXT/DECISIONS.md. Otherwise, omit this step. [verified]
  5. Run python3 tools/update_context.py update then python3 tools/update_context.py check. Both must exit 0; any new stale-file warnings must be inspected (do not ignore silently). [verified]
